facts.en: Completed a rural stores operations diploma at Fictional Alderfurrow Centre in 2019.
facts.zh: 2019 年在虚构桤木垄中心完成乡村物料库运营文凭课程。

facts.en: Paid stores assistant at Fictional Oatbridge Growers from 2020-03 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2020-03 至 2026-08 在虚构燕麦桥种植合作社任有薪物料库助理。

facts.en: Issued hose sections, fittings and nonpowered hand tools against field supervisors’ approved request slips.
facts.zh: 依据田间主管批准的申请单发放软管段、接头及非动力手工具。

facts.en: Matched supplier part codes and quantities with delivery notes and assigned shelf bins.
facts.zh: 核对供应商零件代码及数量与送货单是否一致，并分配货架储物格。

facts.en: Kept used returns separate from new stock and recorded items awaiting the supervisor’s inspection.
facts.zh: 将使用后归还物与新库存分开，并记录等待主管检查的物品。

facts.en: Field technicians specified fitting compatibility and irrigation layouts; the candidate selected items only from approved codes.
facts.zh: 田间技术员确定接头兼容性及灌溉布局；候选人仅按获批代码选取物品。

facts.en: Prepared labeled issue bundles for early field departures and noted unfilled requests.
facts.zh: 为清晨田间出工准备贴有标签的领料包，并记录未满足的申请。

facts.en: Uses bin cards, barcode scans and spreadsheet stock filters.
facts.zh: 使用储物格卡片、条码扫描及电子表格库存筛选。

facts.en: Helped recount hose-fitting stock before the 2025 planting season.
facts.zh: 在 2025 年种植季前协助重新清点软管接头库存。

facts.en: Personally counted 62 bins; a colleague counted 38 other bins, with no overlap in assigned bins.
facts.zh: 个人清点 62 个储物格；一名同事清点另外 38 个储物格，分配的储物格没有重叠。

facts.en: Across the 100-bin team count, 7 bin cards differed from the physical quantities and were sent for supervisor review.
facts.zh: 团队清点的 100 个储物格中，7 张储物格卡与实物数量不同，已送交主管审核。

facts.en: The recount log gives no total stock value and no confirmed financial loss for those differences.
facts.zh: 重新盘点日志未给出库存总价值，亦未确认这些差异造成的财务损失。

facts.en: Sent a weekly list of low-stock approved parts to the purchasing clerk.
facts.zh: 每周向采购文员发送获批零件的低库存清单。

facts.en: Completed internal manual-handling and stores-access induction in 2020-03.
facts.zh: 2020-03 完成内部人工搬运及物料库访问入职培训。

facts.en: The supplied records contain no equipment-driving licence or irrigation-system design qualification.
facts.zh: 所提供记录不含设备驾驶执照或灌溉系统设计资格。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Sunbutton Community Garden from 2022-05 to 2025-10.
facts.zh: 2022-05 至 2025-10 在虚构太阳纽扣社区花园做志愿者。

facts.en: At that garden, organized a shared hand-tool sign-out sheet and labeled 23 tool hooks.
facts.zh: 在该花园整理共享手工具借用表，并为 23 个工具挂钩贴标签。

facts.en: Helped plant donated seedlings during supervised weekend sessions; no crop-yield study was conducted.
facts.zh: 在受监督的周末活动中协助种植捐赠幼苗；未开展作物产量研究。

facts.en: Keeps a personal notebook of invented allotment layouts drawn for enjoyment.
facts.zh: 保留个人笔记，绘制虚构菜园布局作为消遣。

facts.en: Enjoys collecting and sketching unusually shaped seed pods.
facts.zh: 爱好收集并素描形状独特的种荚。
